title: Project Amethyst
description: A Project based upon adding Unique Items relating to Amethyst
body:
Project Amethyst adds many new Fictional weapons and items relating to Amethyst.

This mod is a heavy Work In Progress and is nowhere near complete

## Current Features


- Purified Amethyst
  - (A more refined version of amethyst, used to create many of the new items)
  - ![Pure Amethyst](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/31013ad9ea4eb00c3d4a50ace30a0df17113427c.png)




- The Amethyst Talisman
  - (A Talisman that saves you from taking fall damage by using Spare Amethyst as Fuel)
  - ![Amethyst Talisman](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5489e0286d8fce7d697af85547c46bafff13bcd3.png)




- Amethyst Zilyc
  - [Sword]
  - (A Weapon that gives you the possible chance of dealing additional damage to your enemy)
  - {Requires Amethyst Talisman for Additional Power}
  - ![Amethyst Zilyc](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/868e8054247ce611d941f812f1931927a478f3a2.png)




- Amethyst Aurokate
  - [Axe]
  - (A Weapon that lets you extract Amethyst from trees somehow. It also gives you Physical Prowess over your enemies)
  - {Requires Amethyst Talisman for Additional Power}
  - ![Amethyst Aurokate](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/97a87031913153fc0e08daec8b8b2a7baace8b04.png)




- Amethyst Crown
  - [Helmet]
  - (A noble helmet that gives you +5 Armor, along with 2.5 Armor Toughness)
  - {Armor Trims not Recommended, but are Compatible}
  - ![Amethyst Crown](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2bef6f61eee581c8c2859f64d5db19515bbe33cb.png)




- Prowess Potion
  - (A 4-tier potion that gives you minor toughness and speed boosts)
  - {Requires Mundane Bottles]
  - ![Prowess Potion Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/516432630ea5814deb9904df2cca6493a8ccfdd4.png)
  - ![Prowess Potion Effects](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a0614a32508f26a1165ff9ff48bf0165021f2d64.png)





This project also includes Amethyst Stairs and Slabs (More blocks to come in the future)

There are Netherite Variants of the Amethyst Zilyc and the Amethyst Aurokate

This mod is a side project of mine and won't be updated Frequently, But it will be updated.
